profile_name: Dirk Phyl Investments (Pty) Ltd (Dominionville) - electricity recharge (scanned, OCR)
_doc: Dirk Phyl Investments (Pty) Ltd (Dominionville) landlord electricity recharge invoices - ALL 10 are SCANS read by OCR. Two layouts: older 'Tax Invoice' (Date, BTW Registrasienr., Document No INA..., Account row, Code | Description | Quantity | Unit | Unit Price | Tax | Nett Price, Sub Total, Amount Excl Tax, Total) and newer 'Tax Invoice' (Number DP..., VAT No, Date, Due Date, 'NNN : TFMC' account, Description | Quantity | Unit | Excl. Price | Disc% | VAT% | Exclusive Total | Inclusive Total, Total Exclusive, Total VAT, Sub Total incl). Two lines: BASIES Basiese heffing (-> other_r) and ELEK Elektrisiteit verbruik (quantity = kWh, R/kWh, exclusive amount -> standard band). Patterns are tight and dates must be valid dd/mm/yyyy (one OCR'd '94/..' date stays blank; the Due Date is never used). total_ex_vat_r = basic + energy. IDENTITY = printed Total Exclusive / Amount Excl Tax (garbled OCR lines matched loosely after 'Exclusive:'): 0.00 on 10/10; second check kWh x R/kWh = energy amount on 10/10. Fingerprint any of the biller VAT number / name (OCR breaks either on some scans). OCR caveat: one bill's account number reads differently from the other nine (likely a misread digit) - rows from scans need human verification.
